==Biography==
Diego Alonso Apablaza Abarzúa was born in Santiago, Chile.

=== 2016 Season===
His debut was in [[Isurus]] as Jungle participating in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup]] rotating with [[Clatos]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup Playoffs]] where the team arrived in the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 2-3.

=== 2017 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[QQmore]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Opening]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Opening Playoffs]] where the team reached the final facing [[Furious Gaming]] winning 3-0, being champion for the first time, qualifying for an international tournament for the first time. Already in the MSI the team was in group B facing [[GIGABYTE Marines]], [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]] and [[Virtus.pro]], where the team was last in the group phase. At the middle of the year [[QQmore]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]] where the team reached the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 1-3.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[QQmore]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying for the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] where the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] 0-3. In the middle of the year [[QQmore]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] where the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Rebirth eSports]] 0-3, at the end of the tournament leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Pixel Esports Club|Pixel Esports]] as Jungle participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was fifth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] the team was fifth in the tournament losing against [[Isurus]] 1-3. In the middle of the year [[QQmore]] remains in the team participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was last in the tournament, having to play the relegation. Already in [[LLA 2020 Opening Promotion]] the team faced [[MAD Lions E.C. Colombia|MAD Lions Colombia]] winning 3-1, saving the place.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Lee Sin}}.
* He also likes {{ci|Ekko}}, {{ci|Elise}}, and {{ci|Lucian}}.
* Reached Master tier on KR server.
